cover.title: 5 niche things superintelligence can't see on your website

inner.title: javascript-only content
inner.body: vercel's crawl study (dec 2024) found no major ai crawler renders javascript. gptbot and claudebot fetched js files and ran none, so a pricing table built in the browser is a blank page to them.

inner.title: pages that 404
inner.body: in that study 34.82% of chatgpt's crawler fetches and 34.16% of claude's hit 404 pages, against 8.22% for googlebot. every old url you forgot is a visit they spent on nothing.

inner.title: redirect chains
inner.body: chatgpt's crawler spent 14.36% of its fetches following redirects, googlebot 1.49%. every extra hop between your link and your page is one more place they stop.

inner.title: a robots.txt block
inner.body: openai's docs say a site that disallows oai-searchbot won't appear in chatgpt search answers. one copied rule can hide you, and changes take about 24 hours to show.

inner.title: visits robots.txt skips
inner.body: chatgpt-user fetches a page when someone asks a question, and openai says robots.txt rules may not apply to it. your server logs know who read you, your rules file doesn't.

closer.HEADLINE:
they read what you ship.
not what you meant.
closer.SUBLINE: your best page may be blank to the bots that matter.
